expected.speaker: June
expected.zh: 我收留的是一只猫。后来喜欢上了一个人。两件事，都不是你们替我决定的。

heard: veil a dub form i knew would fill witness why wary
full: Veil a dub form I knew would fill witness.  Why, Wary?  Of course.  You're not their tool for keeping a gate open.

heard: deb could you get vale to stop
full: Deb, could you get Vale to stop, looking for someone?  Start with a form.  We have three.

heard: you don t have to promise the ritual will work with love
full: Then you decide whether to witness anything.  You don't have to promise the ritual will work with love.
